summary: Executed tests for the 'Cannot convert undefined or null to object' fix when saving settings/logo. Backend: tests/test_iter18_settings_logo.py 17/17 PASS. UI (Playwright 1920, TEMP FULL tenant with no settings doc at all): Settings loads with plan FULL; settings-save-button -> PUT /api/settings 200, toast 'Setări salvate', no 'Cannot convert undefined or null to object' error, no pageerror. Upload of a valid 191-byte PNG via settings-custom-logo-input -> PUT /api/settings/logo 200, settings-custom-logo-preview shows a data:image/png src; then name change + save -> 200, and after reload both the logo preview and the name are kept (DB: custom_logo_mime image/png). BASIC: settings-custom-logo-input and subdomain disabled, settings-logo-plan-note shows Performa branding, save 200 without error; direct PUT /api/settings/logo -> 403. PUT /api/settings with kind/plan_limits/subscription_plan/tenant_id/branch_id/custom_logo_data_url/custom_logo_mime/custom_subdomain:null -> 200; DB doc has kind 'company', correct tenant_id/branch_id, no plan_limits/subscription_plan, logo and mime unchanged (the existing PNG), custom_subdomain None (not 'none'). Cleanup: 0 TEMP/TEST tenants, users or settings left; only the 3 original tenants remain.

minor.issue: Accepts an arbitrary dict (body: dict) without a Pydantic whitelist. Fields not on the blacklist (e.g. custom_logo_* variants, unknown keys) are persisted as-is.

ui_bugs.issue: vat_rate and payment_terms_days are empty for a new tenant, and save() sends Number('')||0, which persists vat_rate=0 and payment_terms_days=0. A new FULL/BASIC tenant that clicks Save once gets 0% VAT. Use a default (21 / 30) or omit empty fields.

issues: React warning 'A component is changing an uncontrolled input to be controlled' (vat_rate/payment_terms_days/series inputs bound to undefined; use ?? '').
There is no button to remove the custom logo.

action_items: Default vat_rate (21) and payment_terms_days (30) on a sparse tenant: do not send 0 when the input is empty.
Make the Settings inputs controlled (value={f.x ?? ''}) to remove the React warning.
Optional: replace body: dict in PUT /settings with a Pydantic model (field whitelist).
critical_code_review_comments: uploadLogo uses setF({...f, ...data}) with a stale closure of f. Edits made between file selection and the response would be lost (very small window).
Default deploy: get_settings returns no defaults for vat_rate. Business logic that reads settings.vat_rate on a new tenant may compute 0% VAT.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md (owner SUPERADMIN). Passwords and Base64 are not exposed.
seed_data_creation: TEMP-ui16-FULL SRL and TEMP-ui16-BASIC SRL were created and then deleted via the API + DB cleanup. Verified 0 leftovers.

rca of the issue: The original error came from Object.entries/Object.keys on f.labor_rates undefined for tenants without settings. The fix (f.labor_rates || {}, elevators || []) plus the backend blacklist on scope/plan/logo fields is confirmed working.
